pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Product Names from Verified Evidence
lesson.when: a customer refers to a previously discussed item without naming it explicitly and there is no evidence establishing the exact product details
lesson.do: ask the customer to confirm the specific product name or details before assuming or stating any product identity
lesson.otherwise: state clearly that the product details are not available in the system context instead of guessing product names
triggers: gọi tiếp về món đã hỏi
